script:
tell application "Finder"
	if (count of Finder windows) is 0 then error "No Finder window is open. Open a folder, then press ⌘⇧K."
	try
		return POSIX path of (target of front Finder window as alias)
	on error
		set sel to selection
		if (count of sel) > 0 then return POSIX path of (item 1 of sel as alias)
		error "“" & (name of front Finder window) & "” isn’t a folder on disk. Select a file in it, or open a real folder."
	end try
end tell
name: {path|basename}

script:
set theTitle to ""
tell application "System Events" to tell process "Bear"
	set frontmost to true
	-- The window title IS the note title. Read it here, with the Accessibility
	-- grant this block already needs, rather than from Bear's database, which
	-- sits in a group container macOS now protects ("authorization denied").
	try
		set theTitle to name of front window
	end try
	click menu item "Copy Link" of menu "Note" of menu bar 1
end tell
delay 0.2
set theLink to (the clipboard as text)
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "id="
set idPart to last text item of theLink
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "&"
set noteId to first text item of idPart
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to ""
set dbPath to (POSIX path of (path to home folder)) & "Library/Group Containers/9K33E3U3T4.net.shinyfrog.bear/Application Data/database.sqlite"
if theTitle is "" or theTitle is "Bear" then
	try
		set theTitle to do shell script "sqlite3 -readonly " & quoted form of dbPath & " " & quoted form of ("SELECT ZTITLE FROM ZSFNOTE WHERE ZUNIQUEIDENTIFIER='" & noteId & "' LIMIT 1;")
	end try
end if
return theTitle & tab & theLink
name: {title}

script: tell application "Things3" to return (id of item 1 of (selected to dos)) & "\t" & (name of item 1 of (selected to dos))
